submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker records operator=Oracle for Lordstown, Ohio. submissions.title: Stargate UAE's first phase to be completed in third quarter of 2026
submissions.excerpt: Stargate UAE's first phase, delivering 200 megawatts of the 1-gigawatt AI infrastructure, is due for completion
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker's expected_opening_date (2026-12-31) reads as if it applies to the full 1000MW estimated figure, but sources consistently state only Phase 1 (200MW, ~20% of the 1GW cluster) is targeted for Q3 2026; full 1GW buildout is separately reported to take about three years from groundbreaking (~2028), per G42/Khazna statements. This is exactly the 'target vs current' conflation pattern the audit is hunting for, applied to a timeline field rather than a power figure. Recommend either recording a phased estimate (200MW by Q3 2026 / 1000MW full-build) or moving expected_opening_date to reflect full-1GW completion so it isn't read as the date the recorded 1000MW is reached. G42 primary source (g42.ai) not independently fetched this session — outbound access blocked by sandbox egress policy.

claims.methodology: News report (The National, citing G42/Khazna) states Phase 1 delivers 200MW of the 1GW cluster by Q3 2026. Basis: unclear (IT vs site) from this source. Not fetched directly from G42 primary source this session (sandbox egress blocked), so capped at MEDIUM despite operator-adjacent sourcing.

submissions.title: Le préfet de Seine-et-Marne a validé le projet Campus IA de Fouju (1,4 GW et 50 milliards €)
submissions.excerpt: Le préfet de Seine-et-Marne a validé le projet Campus IA de Fouju (1,4 GW et 50 milliards €)
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker status is PERMITTING, but four prefectoral decrees dated 2026-07-29 (n° 2026-07/DCSE/BPE/E authorizing the campus + n° 2026-31/32/33 authorizing SPV1/SPV2/SPV4 to operate DC1/DC2/DC4) formally approved the project — the public inquiry the tracker's PERMITTING status refers to has concluded. A legal challenge ('recours') has since been filed by opposition associations, and first-phase construction was reported targeted for September 2026 (i.e. now). Recommend updating status to reflect the permit having been granted (e.g. 'PERMITTED / under legal challenge') rather than still-pending PERMITTING, and flagging litigation risk in the analyst note. The existing 700MW-contracted-vs-1400MW-target split from the prior audit is unaffected and needs no change. Primary government source (seine-et-marne.gouv.fr/.../DECISIONS) and the Senate record were not independently fetched this session — outbound access blocked by sandbox egress policy; this finding rests on secondary corroboration (DCMag, Next.ink, JSS, an Instagram post quoting the four arrêtés by number, all consistent on the 2026-07-29 decree dates and the legal challenge).

submissions.title: HUMAIN partners with DataVolt to jointly develop 100MW of a 360MW AI data center project in NEOM
submissions.excerpt: HUMAIN partners with DataVolt to jointly develop 100MW of a 360MW AI data center project in NEOM
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker status is ANNOUNCED with the analyst note stating 'no construction documented' and 'first ~300MW targeted for 2028'. HUMAIN and DataVolt broke ground on Oxagon's first phase around 2026-08-31 (multiple outlets: AGBI, SaudiGulf Projects, DataVolt's own site), described as a 360MW first phase within the wider 1.5GW campus target, of which 100MW is the initial HUMAIN/DataVolt joint tranche (targeted ready 2028). Recommend updating status to UNDER_CONSTRUCTION and refining the '~300MW phase one' estimate to the now-disclosed 360MW figure. The 1500MW estimated_power_mw figure and $5B phase-one capex remain correctly labeled as targets, not current capacity — no change needed there. Not independently fetched from neom.com this session — outbound access blocked by sandbox egress policy; confidence capped at MEDIUM despite this being a company-primary headline recovered via search indexing.
